bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, the North Chennai Thermal Power Station suffered a 600 MW power generation drop due to a boiler tube leak, and officials must monitor restoration.
In Chennai, a 10-foot giant sinkhole suddenly formed on the OMR road in Perungudi due to drainage leakage, and the office should watch traffic and repair work.
A netizen urged the minister to apply the same road-widening speed to the Velachery-Tambaram road after a new state highway was built in Sathankulam-Nazareth.
In Kanagam, Housing Board residents protested after officials repeatedly pressured them to vacate the homes they purchased, and the constituency team should look into it.
In Pallikaranai, the Aram Thinai climate action group is launching its second organic farmers market following a successful first year in T. Nagar.
In Thiruttani, the family of soldier Aribabu mourned his death from a bike accident while on duty in Gujarat, and local officials should offer support.
In Avadi, Tiruvallur Collector Kavitha and local officials inspected dengue prevention measures, and the district team should continue tracking health protocols.
In Thiruvallur, Joint Registrar Jayasree inspected crop loan waiver work at the Othappai Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society.
Tamil Nadu is launching a new ration shop system that replaces fingerprint authentication with facial scanning for item distribution.
In Coimbatore, over 75 Global Capability Centres are operating, with projections to reach 200 by 2032 based on engineering talent and industrial strength.
Apple removed the offline messaging app Bitchat from the India App Store following a takedown demand from MeitY under Section 69A.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the IITM-Maestro music centre at IIT Madras on October 11, combining culture, technology, and neuroscience.
